title: Bishoujo Senshi Sailor Moon SuperS: Zenin Sanka!! Shuyaku Soudatsusen
aliases: Bishoujo Senshi Sailor Moon SuperS – Zenin Sanka!! Shuyaku Soudatsusen
description: A Super Famicom fighting game based on the magical girl anime and manga Sailor Moon. The game features all of the Sailor Scouts as playable fighters and they once again fight each other to determine their leader.
